cause_quote: The new first-launch path called `self.install_cli` with `InstallChannel::Dev` for non-release builds, sending fresh Windows installs into an installer branch that rejected that channel.
user_saw: On a fresh non-release Windows desktop install without an existing CLI, automatic setup showed an error and dropped back to manual setup.
summary: The fix bundles the same commit's core CLI and Codex plugin in non-release Linux and Windows Tauri builds so fresh setup can install them locally.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and its parent: #169512 added automatic local setup, while the previous startup path only attempted to connect. The Windows installer already rejected Development in #169522, so the new automatic path shipped with a deterministic failure on fresh non-release Windows installs without a CLI.
